title: Record email labeling baseline scorecard
description:
Record the scorecard for `ghost` and `saleor` email labels on the current scanner, before any analysis epic lands.

## Done when

The baseline artifact is committed and linked here, with mention precision, the attribute metrics (expected mostly not computable yet), and grouping metrics, each with its computability state. Later analysis epics report against this baseline.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Provisional baseline recorded on kdatap-1c4998-baseline (draft PR stacked on #92). Email-only: ghost recall 164/272, precision 164/390, negatives clean 459/639; saleor recall 98/217, precision 98/156, negatives clean 378/435. Most false positives are comment lines and string prose. Re-run on accepted gold after review.
